title: Shaman
text:
Shaman is an Ascendancy class for the Druid.


== Overview ==
The Shaman unleashes the force of nature upon his foes. Druidic Champion causes his rage to benefit spellcasting power, and Furious Wellspring lets him passively regenerate rage at the cost of adding a rage cost to his skills. The Shaman gains access to passives that grant Adaptation to help defend him against elemental damage that was previously dealt to him. With Turning of the Season, the Shaman gains improved elemental damage and exposure effect, and Bringer of the Apocalypse lets the Shaman unleash an elemental Apocalypse onto the battlefield after dealing enough elemental damage. Sacred Flow grants additional spirit for each empty charm slot, and Wisdom of the Maji unlocks hidden powers within in Runes and Idols.
